призьба.text: Developed from *при́ізба (*prýizba), a univerbation of при (pry, “at, by”) + (obsolete) ізба́ (izbá, “izba, (peasant's) log hut, cottage”), from Old Ruthenian изба (izba). Compare Belarusian пры́зба (prýzba), Polish przyzba, przyźba. (Romanian prispă is borrowed from Ukrainian при́спа (prýspa), which is dialectally synonymous with, but etymologically distinct from, при́зьба (prýzʹba).)
